transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

It’s mostly my sleep. It’s gotten… pretty badly off. For a while I’d sleep two or three hours and then be up making plans, feeling like I was ready to start the day. Now I’m just awake before dawn, tense in my stomach, not feeling rested at all.
Have you been worrying a lot about things lately?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t call it worrying exactly… I just feel on edge sometimes. It’s hard to separate from the sleep.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?

Not really, no. I used to spend hours at the museum, or with my camera… cooking, even cards. Lately I look at the camera or think about going to the bridge table, and it just feels like effort. Like I’d be pretending.
Do you feel like you're not getting pleasure from things that normally would give you pleasure?

Yes. I used to lose whole afternoons at the museum, or with my camera… cooking, bridge, things like that. Lately I look at them and I just feel nothing, really. Mostly just how much effort it would take to pretend I’m enjoying it.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad most of the time. It’s more… flat, I guess. I don’t have a better word for it.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say anxious most of the time… maybe tense sometimes, but I haven’t really been paying attention to it.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge for no specific reason?
Not especially. I mean… I get unsettled now and then, but I can’t say it’s often or for no reason.
Do you feel like something is always worrying you in the back of your mind?
I’m not sure. I don’t think there’s one thing always running in the background like that… not that I’ve noticed.
Do you often feel afraid or fearful for no specific reason?
No… I don’t think so. I can’t say I feel afraid out of nowhere very often.
Do you feel fearful or anxious most of the time?
No… I wouldn’t say most of the time. I get anxious sometimes, sure, but not like it’s constant.
Do you feel anxious more days than not?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have days where I’m uneasy, but more days than not… I haven’t really kept track like that.
Do you feel anxious on most days?
Not most days, I don’t think. It comes and goes… I haven’t really noticed it being that regular.
Do you feel anxious at least several times a week?
I’m not sure… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really counted it that way. Several times a week sounds like more than I’ve noticed.
Do you feel like anxiety is a problem for you?
I don’t know that I’d call it a problem. It happens now and then, but… I haven’t really thought of it that way.
Do you feel anxious at least several times a month?
I’m not really sure. Maybe here and there, but I haven’t kept track by the month.
Do you feel like anxiety has been a persistent part of your life recently?
I don’t know… persistent sounds like a lot. I wouldn’t say I’ve really noticed it being there all the time.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless?

Yes… I suppose I do. I keep going over that investment decision, and… I tell myself I’ve ruined my wife’s security. Like I made a fool of myself after a whole life of trying to be the responsible one.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About nine months, I think… since those plans fell apart. I’ve been sort of… low and keeping to myself since then.
Have you experienced a significant loss of interest or pleasure in activities for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes… I think so. I used to spend whole afternoons at the museum, or with my camera, cooking, bridge… things like that. Lately I just look at them and feel nothing, really. Mostly it just feels like effort.
How long have you been feeling flat and uninterested in activities?
About nine months… since those plans fell apart. It’s been fairly constant, I suppose.
